name: Aurubis AG
summary: Aurubis AG processes metal concentrates and recycling materials in Germany. The company engages in processing of scrap metals, organic and inorganic metalbearing recycling raw materials, and industrial residues. It also offers copper cast rods and specialty wires, shapes, bars and profiles, industrial rolled products, and architectural rolled products. In addition, the company produces gold, silver, tin, lead, lead-bismuth alloy, lead-antimony litharge, tellurium metals, and tellurium dioxide.
